title: Lockheed Skunk Works response to Grusch's testimony

tellings.quote:
notably their response to gush's
testimony was pretty telling they said
questions about uaps are best answered
by the federal government

plain: In 2023, after a former intelligence officer named David Grusch testified about UAPs (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs), the defense company Lockheed Martin answered that "questions about UAPs are best answered by the federal government." The response was tied to Skunk Works, Lockheed's secret advanced aircraft division. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and calls the reply "pretty telling", because he hears it as a company declining to deny any part in the matter.
